notes.title: Demo Update Dec 9 2024
notes.content:
Sorry for the delay, it took longer than anticipated to include controller support. This is also the last content patch for the demo. Other than bug fixes and minor changes my work going forward will be focused on the upcoming early access version. You can read more detailed early access plans on the Steam discussion board.

Additions
Controller support has been added. Let me know in the discussion page if you find a menu item or something that doesn't work. Along with controller support you can now also use WASD/Space bar to move/select various options.
If you don't care and just want to use a mouse you can also turn the blue controller highlight off via the in-game options menu.

Two new common items have been added: 

Bloody Clover
Increases your luck. In the demo that basically means more drops (gems, health potions, class unique drops like
Gravekeeper's coins).

Twin Sickle
Provides a Multistrike chance. Multistrike grants a chance for melee weapons to launch another 
attack in a random direction.

Also added some missing sound effects, and 2 extra rerolls.

Changes
*Enchant frames in Forge now have a purple border to make them more easily distinguishable from attacks
*Dyrnwyn animation updated
*Damage number display is now rounded to reduce clutter.
*Potions now only get picked up if you are missing health and start disappearing after 30 seconds.
*Dead Pool cast sound changed
*some pickup sounds changed
*reduced the chance of getting basic stat upgrades during level-ups. previously all 5 stats were added to the pool, now only 3 of them (at random) are added. This should make it less likely for them to show up during level-ups until you've exhausted regular passive/attack upgrades.
*Questionable Heritage trait has been reworked, and missing description has been added. You now lose 1 Attack/Def/Agility per level until level 20, when you get +40 to all 3, resulting in a net +20 to all three if you are patient.

Bug Fixes
*Knife of Hearts no longer has infinite range
*Issue with Dyrnwyn Firebrand not working fixed
*Fixed issue with player being unable to get new attacks if passive items slots are all filled
*Fixed issue with forge crashing if you try to craft without selecting an option to craft

notes.title: Demo update Nov 16 2024
notes.content:
Additions
Forge

The last major content addition to the game is now fully functional. You can open the forge by pressing 'E'.

The forge, along with gems you pick up during regular gameplay, can be used to either forge Ultimate Attacks
that cannot be found during level-ups or Enchantments for your passive items with additonal stat bonuses.

Forged Attacks

Attacks created by the forge cost 5 of three different gems (there are 6 gems in total) and require a fully
leveled regular weapon. The basic attack selected will be replaced by the forged Ultimate Attack. You cannot
forge more than one of the same ultimate attack but you can replace all your normal attacks with ultimates if you
have enough gems.

The demo has 7 Ultimate Attacks that can be forged. The final game will have at least 30.

Forged Enchantments

You can add additional stat boosts to your passive items via Enchantments. A passive item must be fully leveled to
be enchanted. There are currently 5 stats that can be Enchanted on passive items (Health, Aura, Attack, Defense and Agility).



Changes
*Rotten Meat now also increases the chance of an enemy to spawn as an Elite by 10%.
*Elites spawn 5 random gems on death
*Normal enemies also have a chance to spawn a gem on death

Bug Fixes
*fixed issue with Elite enemies crashing the game on spawn
*fixed issues with Ill Wind tornadoes not getting bonuses from higher levels

notes.title: Demo update Oct 27 2024
notes.content:
This patch adds a bunch of smaller features and a few bug fixes (no Forge yet).

Additions
*Enemy HP toggle option added
*Damage text on hit toggle option added
*Screen flash when hit toggle option added
*Added player Health bar to upper left interface, as well as numerical values for your current/max health and experience.
*Passive item tooltips now display the item stat provided

Traits
You might have noticed there is(was) a lot of empty space at character selection. That space is mostly meant to be filled by traits. The demo has four traits added. Traits are passive abilities that change the game in some way but don't provide you with bonuses outright, or if they do, they come at a penalty. Thee of the traits increase adjust some stats. The fourth introduces curses.

Curses
The final game will have more than one but the demo has one curse: Curse of Dis. Picking this trait will cause you to be haunted by the very annoying specter of Dis, a long dead lich. It moves slowly but cannot be attacked and his power grows the more cursed items you take on and level.


New Passive Items

Common Items:
Pocket Bible +1 resurrection. You gain attack/defense every time you resurrect.
Rotten Meat Enemies have 20% more attack, defense and health per item level and spawn slightly faster. This mostly just makes the game harder.
Wicker Doll Increases Retaliation damage and gives you a small chance to KO enemies on a retaliation attack
Sextant Increases Multishot chance. Multishot is a chance to double the number of projectiles fired by projectile attacks

New Item rarities: Cursed and Rare. They will show up less often than regular items at level-ups. Rares are usually better than regular items.

Cursed Items:
Left Hand, Right Hand, Black Heart and Evil Eye of Dis. These items won't show up unless you pick the "Curse of Dis trait"

Rare Item:
Sin Eater - Reduce curse potency. Every level of a cursed item you get makes curses stronger and this item can make that more manageable. Not useful and won't show up if you don't pick the "Curse of Dis" trait as that's the only curse in the demo. This is also the only rare item in the demo (sorry to disappoint), although I might add a couple more later.



Changes
*Gravekeeper shovel as well as the weapons of the upgraded classes(Cryptkeeper, Laborer) have been modified. Greatly reduced their size scaling and doubled their starting damage and per level damage bonus
*Passive items will now show cumulative stat gains on levelup
*Blade Dancer damage bonus increased to 50/100/150
*Changed Fullscreen, Restart and Quit buttons to F1, F5 and F12 respectively

Bug Fixes
*Blade Dancer damage formula fixed.
*Status Effect damage did twice the damage/tick it was supposed to, this has been fixed.

notes.title: Demo update Oct 24 2024
notes.content:
This update is mostly focused around increasing the gameplay variety during a run.

Additions
Status Effects VIsuals
On hit DOT effects like Burn and Plague now have a visual effect when first applied

SFX reduction option Check this to reduce the chance of sound effect to play on an attack if you find them too annoying.
I don't really like how this function works but if there are attack sounds that you find too annoying they won't play as often.

Enemy summon events 
Occasionally enemy summonings (telegraphed by red pentagram summoning circles) will spawn in

Elite enemies 
On occasion some enemies will spawn as elite versions of themselves. Elite enemies are bigger than normal enemies and all of their stats are better: they have much higher health, more attack, more defense, more damage, smaller cooldown for attacks and abilities, and are tagged as bosses (which means KO abilities will just reduce their health by a small % instead of killing them instantly).
They drop more XP than a normal enemy, and when the forge update drops they will have guaranteed gem drops as well

Map Events  Random map events added. They can be found by wandering around. Right now it's just stat boost structures. Stand near them to charge them and get a small stat boost for the rest of that run.

Changes
*Changed levelup visual effect
*Shield will now decay much quicker if your shield value is larger than your aura range
*Wizard's Sight Beyond Sight skill now provides +1atk/levelup for every point you have in the skill.
*Skills you have no points in will appear dimmed on the levelup screen, to make it easier to identify which skills you've put points in without having to hover the mouse over them.

Bug Fixes

*Fixed Salt Alchemy description to accurately reflect how much shield you actually get.
*Fixed issue with Forgemaster skill not boosting defense.
*Changed weapon code for Gravekeeper & her associated classes, and reduced the number of particles that spawn when enemies appear. Hopefully
this will eliminate any lag associated with destroying large numbers of enemies at once.


Next update will focus on the forge and if I have time, controller support and updated tooltips.

notes.title: Demo Update Oct 19 2024
notes.content:
Additions
Tier 1 class upgrades have been added. Class upgrades give you access to 3 additional skills and modify the character's primary weapon with additional effects. They are available after spending 5 skill points
Gravekeeper can be upgraded to either a Cryptkeeper or a Labourer
Bandit can be upgraded to a Houndmaster or Sharpshooter
Occultist can be upgraded to a Necromancer or Wizard.

*Added visual effect on character when leveling up.

Changes
*Improved Graveyard boss visibility.
*slightly reduced Death Rain range and considerably reduced level 5 explosion damage.
*Increased the power of some of the enemies. Will probably make regular adjustments to it as the launch version is too much of a cakewalk (except for the boss)
*Reduced number of gravestones that spawn in the graveyard.
*removed/reduced frequency of some sound effects, including enemy death sounds and Phoenix Burst. 


Bug Fixes
*Defense now works properly. Good news if you're the Gravekeeper, bad news for the other two classes.
*Shadow Domain now properly inflicts Curse at level 5.


The class upgrades took longer than I thought so unfortunately the Forge update won't happen this week. ETA is next Friday, but it might come sooner if it turns out to be less complicated than I thought.
